title: Deconvolve (CaImAn)
description: Spikes and denoised calcium of each trace by CaImAn's OASIS, when it is installed, with dev's options (its CaImAn deconvolution): thresholded OASIS, spikes of at least spikeSnr times the trace's noise (CaImAn's GetSn), the sparsity penalty CaImAn's choose_lambda gives at lambdaPr (none at dev's 0.5), and the AR coefficients of tauRise and tauDecay as dev's exp2ar gives them, or estimated from each trace. MATLAB runs deconvolveCa ('thresholded'; exp2 with onnls), Python the OASIS class (exp2, the same kernel as AR(2), as AR(2)).

signals.title: Traces
signals.description: Variable that holds the traces (frames x ROIs).

output.title: Spikes
output.description: Variable the result is saved to.

denoisedOutput.title: Denoised calcium
denoisedOutput.description: Variable the denoised calcium is saved to. Leave empty to not save it.

modelType.title: Model
modelType.description: The calcium kernel (dev's modelType): ar1, ar2, exp2 (a difference of exponentials), or autoar (AR(2) above 15 Hz, else AR(1), its coefficients estimated)

estimateTimeConstants.title: Estimate time constants
estimateTimeConstants.description: Estimate the AR coefficients from each trace (CaImAn's estimate_time_constant) instead of using tauRise and tauDecay

spikeSnr.title: Spike SNR
spikeSnr.description: The smallest spike, in units of the trace's noise

lambdaPr.title: Sparsity probability
lambdaPr.description: choose_lambda's probability: the sparsity penalty is the noise times the kernel's norm times the normal distribution's inverse at it (0 at 0.5)
